name: DC port connection observations
description: VMConnection observations for destination ports 1-1024 during the selected range. Sum of LinksLive is an interval observation count, not a current connection count or proof that a service is currently reachable.
kql:
VMConnection
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| where DestinationPort between (1 .. 1024)
| summarize LiveLinkObservations = sum(LinksLive), LastLiveObservation = maxif(TimeGenerated, LinksLive > 0), LastTerminationObservation = maxif(TimeGenerated, LinksTerminated > 0), FailedLinkObservations = sum(LinksFailed), LastFailureObservation = maxif(TimeGenerated, LinksFailed > 0) by Computer, DestinationPort
| extend LiveLinksObserved = LiveLinkObservations > 0
| project Computer, DestinationPort, LiveLinksObserved, LiveLinkObservations, FailedLinkObservations, LastLiveObservation, LastTerminationObservation, LastFailureObservation
| order by Computer asc, DestinationPort asc
